description: Source code for managing MQTT brokers, including functions for adding, deleting, and configuring MQTT broker instances, with associated data structures and parameter handling.

methods.name: duplicate_entry_exist
methods.description: Checks if a duplicate MQTT broker entry with the given name and section type exists.

methods.name: addMQTTBroker
methods.description: Adds a new MQTT broker section with specified parameters.

methods.name: delMQTTBroker
methods.description: Deletes MQTT broker sections based on the specified delete action.

methods.name: browseMQTTBrokerInst
methods.description: Iterates over MQTT broker instances and links them to the parent node.

methods.name: get_MQTT_BrokerNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the number of MQTT broker entries.

methods.name: get_MQTTBroker_Alias
methods.description: Gets the alias of an MQTT broker.

methods.name: set_MQTTBroker_Alias
methods.description: Sets the alias of an MQTT broker.

methods.name: get_MQTTBroker_Enable
methods.description: Retrieves the enable status of an MQTT broker.

methods.name: set_MQTTBroker_Enable
methods.description: Sets the enable status of an MQTT broker.

methods.name: get_MQTTBroker_Name
methods.description: Retrieves the name of an MQTT broker.

methods.name: set_MQTTBroker_Name
methods.description: Sets the name of an MQTT broker, with validation for duplicates and renaming.

methods.name: get_MQTTBroker_Port
methods.description: Retrieves the port number of an MQTT broker.

methods.name: set_MQTTBroker_Port
methods.description: Sets the port number of an MQTT broker.

methods.name: get_MQTTBroker_Interface
methods.description: Retrieves the network interface associated with an MQTT broker.

methods.name: set_MQTTBroker_Interface
methods.description: Sets the network interface for an MQTT broker, validating allowed objects.

methods.name: get_MQTTBroker_Username
methods.description: Retrieves the username for MQTT broker authentication.

methods.name: set_MQTTBroker_Username
methods.description: Sets the username for MQTT broker authentication.

methods.name: get_MQTTBroker_Password
methods.description: Retrieves the password for MQTT broker authentication (returns empty string).

methods.name: set_MQTTBroker_Password
methods.description: Sets the password for MQTT broker authentication.
